1.name: Probability and Statistics
topics: Sample space, events, independent events, mutually exclusive events
mean, median, mode and standard deviation
discrete random variables and probability mass functions
Continuous random variables and probability distribution function
uniform, exponential, Poisson, normal, standard normal, t distribution

2.name: Linear Algebra
topics: linear dependence and independence of vectors
projection matrix, orthogonal matrix, idempotent matrix, partition matrix and their properties
systems of linear equations and solutions; Gaussian elimination

4.name: Programming, Data Structures and Algorithms
topics: basic data structures: stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, hash tables
Search algorithms: linear search and binary search
basic sorting algorithms: selection sort, bubble sort and insertion sort
basic graph algorithms: traversals and shortest path

5.name: Database Management and Warehousing
topics: relational model: relational algebra, tuple calculus, SQL
data transformation such as normalization, discretization, sampling, compression
data warehouse modelling: schema for multidimensional data models

Supervised Learning: simple linear regression, multiple linear regression
cross-validation methods such as leave-one-out (LOO) cross-validation, k-folds cross-validation
Unsupervised Learning: hierarchical clustering, top-down, bottom-up: single-linkage, multiple-linkage

7.name: AI
topics: reasoning under uncertainty topics — conditional independence representation
